claims.claim: Calculator maps cost per lead, cost per booked job, and close-rate impact from four user inputs

disclosure: Source: Quo (formerly OpenPhone), 'Small Business Callback Statistics 2026,' analysis of 16.7M missed calls

claims.text: Quo analyzed 16.7 million missed business calls logged by real customers over three months
Professional services, the largest sample in the study at 3.96M calls, returned only 33% of missed calls
Healthcare had the highest callback rate in the study at 41% but still left three of five missed calls unreturned
Quo's illustrative model: missing 10 callable leads a week at a 30% close rate and $1,000 average job value can cost roughly $156,000 a year
Black Arrow's free Lead Response Audit scores a business's response process
Quiz funnel completions land in the CRM and trigger a text reply in 60 seconds
14-day free trial, no card needed, cancel anytime
